description: Screens a project or site for flood zones, wetlands, airport airspace limits, watershed water stress, and natural hazard insurance risks. Pass a project name, city, or coordinates.

cooling_type.description: Cooling system type for water consumption comparison (e.g. 'evaporative', 'direct_liquid').

include_insurance_risk.description: Include natural hazard and property casualty risk metrics.

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 33.4484).

load_mw.description: Target IT electrical load in megawatts for cooling water consumption modeling (e.g. 100).

location.description: City, county, or market location (e.g. 'Abilene, TX', 'Phoenix, AZ').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -112.0740).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to screen environmental constraints at its location (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to screen (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Location or project query for environmental and water screening (e.g. 'Phoenix, AZ').

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

name: audit_environmental_and_site_gates

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.
